About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: The story of beauty, expertise, and exceptional care.
About.missionBody: At our clinic we believe that true beauty begins with proper skin and body care. We provide verified cosmetic-medical services supervised by elite specialists in a safe and refined environment. We strive to be your first destination for everything related to beauty and self-confidence.
About.visionBody: To be the leading clinic in our region in non-surgical aesthetic and refined cosmetic procedures, through medical excellence, innovation, and attention to the finest details.
About.valuesBody: Integrity, expertise, human care, full confidentiality, and the highest safety standards — values we commit to in every visit and every procedure.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.body: We protect your personal data and commit to the highest confidentiality standards. We do not share your data with any third party without your explicit consent. All data is securely stored with fully hashed passwords. We do not store credit card data on our servers.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.body: By using our website you agree to the following terms: adhere to appointment timings, cancel at least 24 hours in advance, pay by card at booking or in cash at the clinic. We reserve the right to cancel any booking in emergencies.
